values.note: Every site is reservable up to 365 days ahead but not on the day of arrival ('Same-day reservations will not be permitted by phone or online'). Without a reservation you may pay on arrival for a site marked AVAILABLE, for one night only; 'Campers who plan to stay more than one night must make a reservation.' Reserved tags are updated by 1 p.m. daily. Check-in after 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/bigrun.aspx ('ALL CAMPSITES AT BIG RUN STATE PARK WILL BE AVAILABLE BY RESERVATION ... Same-day reservations will not be permitted by phone or online. Campers without a reservation will be permitted to pay upon arrival for campsites marked "AVAILABLE" for one night only.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/BigRun/Camping.aspx + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/big-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380102 (Booking Window: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/BigRun/Camping.aspx ('Big Run has 23 primitive campsites available by reservation year-round') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/big-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380102 ('Status: Open year round.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/big-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380102 (all 27 family sites are type 'Campsite Non-Electric') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/BigRun/Primitive-Conditions.aspx ('Drinking Water - Water is not available at Big Run.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 27 non-electric family sites on the booking site (DNR's camping page says 23 primitive sites) plus two group sites. Equipment lengths: 16 sites 20 ft, 3 at 25, 3 at 30, one 40 and one 50 (three unlisted). Sites 63-75 are wooded with stone-dust pads; 78-90 are in an open grassy field.

sites.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/big-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380102 (site list: site type and Equip length/Driveway for all 30 sites) + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/BigRun/Camping.aspx ('Sites 63-75 are wooded, with stone-dust camping pads. Sites 78-90 are in an open grassy field.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two waterless toilet buildings, one at Big Run Road / Savage River Road and one near the Monroe Run Pavilion. No cell phone service.

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/BigRun/Primitive-Conditions.aspx ('Restrooms - Big Run has two waterless toilet facilities ... Drinking Water - Water is not available at Big Run ... No Cell Phone Service'), read 2026-10-21

note: Surrounded by Savage River State Forest, at the head of Savage River Reservoir. There is a lake in the park, but the campground is not lakefront. --Claude  Big Run Road bridge replacement: DNR's park pages say the road closes 1,000 ft north of Savage River Road for up to four months beginning May 2027; the booking site's alert says from September 8, 2026 through December 2026. During the closure sites 60-75 and 123-144 are reached only from New Germany Road, sites 78-89 only from Savage River Road. --Claude 2026-10-21
summary: Confirmed on DNR's park/camping/primitive-conditions pages and the MD booking site: reservable 365 days ahead, no same-day booking (closes 1 day ahead), pay-on-arrival for one night at AVAILABLE sites, open year-round; 27 non-electric sites (DNR says 23) to 50 ft (8 sites 25 ft+), no water, two waterless toilets. Fees left (manual 2026-10-12). Not stated for this park: the weekend/holiday minimums (left inherited), max stay. Added a dated road-closure caveat to the note.
flags: Phone: entry has none; DNR lists 'Contact: (301) 895-5453' for Big Run (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/bigrun.aspx).

Official pages disagree on the Big Run Road closure dates: DNR (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/BigRun/Camping.aspx) says beginning May 2027 for up to four months; the booking site (parkId 380102) says effective September 8, 2026 through December 2026. Both recorded in the note.
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's park page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/bigrun.aspx (consider adding it).
